# weir daemon

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Keep every mirror current: sync, wait, repeat, until stopped.

```text
Keep every mirror current: sync, wait, repeat, until stopped

Usage: weir daemon [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --interval <INTERVAL>
          Seconds between cycles (default: the `interval_seconds` setting)

      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
